about: One-time map from every pre-migration free-text `domain` label to a taxonomy id (data/taxonomy.yaml). `labels` is keyed by topic, then the label exactly as it appeared; `entries` counts pool + archive entries that carried it. Where a label was ambiguous the call was made entry by entry: `entry_overrides` (keyed by entry id) wins over the label's id. Applied by scripts/migrate_taxonomy.py (idempotent) and re-applied on every rerank so other branches' pools converge.
